questions.subject: chemistry
questions.content: Which of the following facts about the complex [Cr (NH<sub>3</sub>)<sub>6</sub> ]Cl<sub>3</sub> is wrong?

options.content: The complex is an outer orbital complex
The complex gives white precipitate with silver nitrate solution
The complex involves d<sup>2</sup>sp<sup>3</sup> hybridization and is octahedral in shape.
